notes.title: VFUN App – Access Issue Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33751039/e2d9e9665db37f1dc95433878be77ce41a5bc628.png[/img]
Hello Rangers,

We’re currently investigating an issue with the VFUN App that’s causing login difficulties for some users. The issue has been identified, and our team is working swiftly to resolve it.

Please Note:
At this time, accounts linked via Google, Facebook, or Apple cannot be accessed through the VFUN App.

We appreciate your patience and understanding while our team works on a fix. Your continued support helps us push forward in delivering the best possible experience.

VFUN Lounge Link Post: [url=https://vfun-lounge.valofe.com/page/ca_reloaded/all/26742][Link][/url]

Stay sharp, stay updated — and thank you for being part of Combat Arms: Reloaded.

a. Time: 2024.04.01 ~ 2024.04.30

e. The effect of combat pro pass used will be valid in this season, and it will end if the season switches.

5. Combat Week Ends
a. Remove BSS GC 2 times mileage
b. Remove Fireteam Rewards
c. Remove EXP/GP 300% buffs during the Combat Week
d. Remove Dead Vacation/Snowball fight

6. Nightmare Boss Rotation
a. Nightmare Boss change to Violent Captain (Lv.100).
b. With the defeat of the boss of Nightmare, the level of the boss will be improved, as well as the rewards. But if you beat a boss with a lower level than your boss, the level of the boss will not be improved.
c. Nightmare requires special respawn tokens
d. When the boss HP drops below 50%, the endurance bar of the boss will be displayed. If you consume the endurance bar of boss, boss will become slow for a period of time and cannot summon the enemy.
E. Boss’effects weapon can consume the boss stamina gauge faster.
f. Starting from level 91, new rewards will be added.

notes.title: COMEBACK REWARDS IMPROVED!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33751039/c7d61b43c4bf7d6abc5167de24ebe5aa30bcf741.jpg[/img]
[h1][b]Exciting News for Combat Arms Reloaded Players! [/b][/h1]

[h2][b]Starting March 13th[/b], our comeback rewards are getting a major upgrade!
Get ready to experience even greater incentives for returning to the battlefield. Whether you've been away for a while or just need a reason to jump back in, now's the perfect time to join us in the action-packed world of Combat Arms Reloaded! 

And that's not all – if you've been offline for 31 days, you'll receive the powerful Takamasa SG550 on your 5th day back, along with Lightning SG550 and a bundle of Epic Weapon Enhance Materials! Plus, more enhancement materials await you on your 6th and 7th days back! Don't miss out on the enhanced comeback rewards – mark your calendars and get ready to claim your rewards![/h2]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33751039/19053738b10cfc4fbfd274ace23887f6ab26b0d5.jpg[/img]
[CHANGE LOGS]

1.Server Stability

2.MA COMPENSATION
a. 200% EXP & GP Boost for 2022.03.30 Maintenance for the rest of the day.
b. Functional Metal 100 pcs
c. Nightmare Respawn Token 15 Pcs (1 day)

•NOTE: MA Compensation can only be obtained on the day of MA

3. New item released (Sale Period: March 30 ~ April 27)

•NOTE: If you buy the x10, 1 permanent item (+0~+4) is guaranteed.

Note 2: Equip the new items. Play game. You can acquire weapon metals. (March 30 ~ April 27)

4. Legendary Backpack Mystery Box released.
a. Legendary Backpack Mystery Box (1, 5, sets, 10 sets) (Sale Period: March 30 ~ April 27)
b. Legendary backpack and the Legendary Backpack mystery box released.
c. It contains various backpacks and legendary backpacks.
d. Unlike other backpacks, Legendary backpacks have defense. Also, the size of the main weapon's magazine has been increased.
e. Also, each legendary backpack has a different ability.

5. Nightmare Boss changed.
a. Nightmare's boss changed to Violent Captain (Lv.100).
b. The more Nightmare's boss is defeated, the higher the boss's level and the more rewards change. However, if you defeat a boss who is lower than my boss level, the boss' level will not go up.
c. Nightmare requires a dedicated response token.
d. The boss' stamina gauge is displayed when the boss's strength is below 50%. By consuming the boss' stamina gauge, the boss slows down for a period of time and does not summon the enemy.
e. Boss effective weapon can consume the boss' stamina gauge faster.
f. From level 91, a new reward added.
g. You can acquire the weapon of the Violent Captain through new reward.

6. April Combat Season Event
a. Period: April 1 ~ April 30
b. You can acquire “Easter” equipment for this Combat Season event.
c. You can earn rewards by acquiring experience points during the season.
d. You can obtain rewards for the Pro Pass by purchasing and using the Combat Pro Pass within the season.
e. The effect of the used Combat Pro Pass is valid for the duration of the season, and the effect ends when the season changes.
f. You can easily acquire Season EXP by purchasing and using Combat Season EXP items.

7. Enhanced item decomposition system has been changed.
a. Upon enhanced item disassembly, you can acquire unmodified items for that item.
b. The quantity of the material obtained in enhanced item decomposition decreases.

8. Combat Week event removed
a. Removal of BSS GC Mileage 2x
b. Removal of the Fireteam Bonus Rewards
c. Removal of the Special Weapons in BSS and Shop
d. Removal of the Snowball Fight and Dead Vacation
e. Removal of the Combat Week Buff EXP / GP 300%

9. April quest content updated.

10. April EXP/GP boost, hot time rewards, daily attendance rewards updated.

11. April Premium Item updated.

12. April Bingo event updated.

13. Clan Zone New Season Begin
a. Clan Zone rewards paid and new Clan Zone season started (Period: March 30 ~ April 27)

14. Bugs fixed
a. The problem of not receiving the first level of compensation during the rank reload has been resolved.
b. Items that have not been paid for Level 1 compensation will be paid in bulk during the maintenance.
c. The problem that the Cosmetics box was not paid during the Level 1 compensation will be resolved, and users who have accessed it by May 24 will be able to receive the Level 1 compensation in the equipment box.

15. April EXP/GP Event

7. Transcendental enhancing and unique items
a. The item that has been enhanced before is now able to enhance transcendence.
b. Transcendental enhancement requires items of materials for transcendental enhancement and is similar to basic enhancement.
c. By enhancing the transcendency, the rating of the item is rising and the ability to enhance special transcendental power may be granted.
d. Items that have risen to transcendence can be enhanced to the next grade without additional enhancement.
e. If you transcend legendary items, it will be the Unique item and your nickname is written to the item.
f. Make your own items through transcendence enhancement.
g. The last applied transcendent option may be changed through the refurbishment.
h. The previously applied options will not change, so you should make a careful decision when raising the rating to two or more levels.
Note: Characters, backpacks, and special weapons cannot enhance transcendence.

f. You can easily acquire Season EXP by purchasing and using Combat Season EXP items.

a. Period: January 31 ~ February 8
b. Starting a new year, we have prepared a special attendance event to help users strengthen.
c. If you complete the attendance for 7 days within the period, you can acquire all the rewards.

[h1]Combat Week[/h1]

notes.title: [INFO] Monthly Bingo System
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33751039/b932564520df3500fc8b6b27a4e3a8b81cb125b7.png[/img]
Attention Rangers!

The Monthly Bingo System has been released! Please take note of the following, to enjoy its rewards!

- Completing a vertical, horizontal, or diagonal line will give you rewards.
- Completing the whole bingo slots will give you the completion reward.
- Activate a slot by acquiring the item shown in each bingo slot.
- Any item that you already have in your inventory is activated
- Clicking a bingo slot will show you ways to activate/acquire the item requirement
- A slot that is showing a lock button means that you just need to unseal that item in your inventory.
- A dark shaded bingo slot means that you don't have that item yet in your inventory
- A light shaded bingo slot means that the slot is already activated

Additional information:
Please note that the following items will be released next month in Combat Season.

1. Devil Soul P90 Green Inferno
2. F2000 Green Inferno
3. M249 Para Green Inferno
4. Green Inferno Mask
5. Green Inferno Vest

Thank you for reading, enjoy playing Combat Arms!

a. A new cosmetic item is sold with the organizer of the secret game, which is executed by the mysterious organization, and a new cosmetic item as a motif.

5. Nightmare Boss changed.
a. Nightmare's boss will be changed to Master Z (Lv.80).
b. The more Nightmare's boss is defeated, the higher the boss's level and the more rewards change. However, if you defeat a boss who is lower than my boss level, the boss' level will not go up.
c. Nightmare requires a dedicated respawn token.
d. The boss' stamina gauge is displayed when the boss's strength is below 50%. By consuming the boss' stamina gauge, the boss slows down for a period of time and does not summon the enemy.
e. Boss effective weapon can consume the boss' stamina gauge faster.

6. This month's bingo system opened!
a. If you complete the bingo by acquiring equipment that goes into the 16-room bingo compartment, you can receive additional rewards.
b. If you have equipment item in the bingo compartment, please unlock it.
c. If you complete all the bingos within the period, you will get a total reward!
(Bingo starts on 27 October, and runs until 30 November. It will be renewed on the 1st of every month.)

7. Bugs fixed
a. Unlimited Ammo bug When picking up gun when it is 0 bullet
b. Enhanced Backpack stats are now reflected correctly in the stats info.

8. Combat Week event removed
a. Removal of BSS GC Mileage 2x
b. Removal of the Fireteam Bonus Rewards
c. Removal of the Special Weapons in BSS and Shop
d. Removal of the Snowball Fight and Dead Vacation
e. Removal of the Combat Week Buff EXP / GP 300%

9. November Combat Season Event
a. Period: November 1st ~ November 30th (October Combat season event completed on October 31st)
b. You can acquire “Green Inferno” equipment for the November Combat Season event.
c. You can earn rewards by acquiring experience points during the season.
d. You can obtain rewards for the Pro Pass by purchasing and using the Combat Pro Pass within the season.
e. The effect of the used Combat Pro Pass is valid for the duration of the season, and the effect ends when the season changes.
f. You can easily acquire Season EXP by purchasing and using Combat Season EXP items.

10. November quest content updated.

11. November EXP/GP boost, hot time rewards, daily attendance rewards updated.

12. November Premium Item updated.

13. Clan Zone New Season Begin
a. Clan Zone rewards paid and new Clan Zone season started (Period: October 27th ~ November 30th)

14. November EXP/GP Event
2021-11-03 00:00 ~ 2021-11-23 23:59 : 4th Anniversary Boost Event (400% EXP / 400% GP)
2021-11-24 00:00 ~ 2021-11-30 23:59 : Combat Week Boost Event (500% EXP / 500% GP)

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33751039/bf216586635dcef08a625af656b01afd6f2071d6.jpg[/img]

[h1]Combat Week[/h1]
[h3]Event Period (10/20 ~ 10/26)[/h3]

Push forward Rangers! Support is on its way for the entire week! Play on and take part in expansive bonuses we got in store just for you.[list]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33751039/53933821fd8ed78ef8351aab7199b659465dbd1d.jpg[/img]
[h1]Super Combat officially opens![/h1]
a. After a month of beta, Super Combat has officially opened.
b. With the official opening, the following contents were applied to Super Combat.
c. An event is holding where you can receive compensation according to the daily ranking and the overall ranking of the event period with the number that defeated rival team members in Super Combat.
[h2]Period: 29 September ~ 26 October.[/h2]

[h1]COUPON CODE: CARSCCode21[/h1]
[h1]Use this code and receive exclusive rewards![/h1]

[h3]Achievements added.[/h3]
a. Two kinds of achievements have been added for Super Combat.

[h3]Adjustment stage 1.[/h3]
a. The number of infections that need to be treated to gain ability is lowered.
b. It increases the ability to treat and acquire infected bodies.
[h3]
Adjustment of stage 2.[/h3]
a. The physical strength of the appearing boss is lowered.
b. The level of skills you acquire is diversified.
c. The two teams may have the same skill, but they may have different levels of skill.

[h3]Adjustment of stage 3.[/h3]
a. Two new maps added. It is Kill creek and short fuse have been added to stage 3.
b. The number of kills required until the end of the game increases.

[h3]Fixing the record bug.[/h3]
a. During the beta period of Super Combat, there was a problem with the general record.
b. There should have been no record of Super Combat during the beta period, but all plays, including NPC's kills, were recorded.
c. In this maintenance, records of all super combats during the beta period will be deleted, and game records will be normalized.
d. The record of the Super Combat, which will be officially opened in the future, will only record the user's record in GENERAL COMBAT RECORD. (The number of NPC kills will not be recorded.)

Period: 29 September ~ 26 October.

6.1. Achievements added.

a. Coupon Code: CARSCCode21
b. Coupon Validity: September 29th ~ October 29th
c. Each account can only use the coupon code only once.

8. Nightmare Boss changed. 
a. Nightmare's boss will be changed to Violent Captain (Lv.80).
b. The more Nightmare's boss is defeated, the higher the boss's level and the more rewards change. However, if you defeat a boss who is lower than my boss level, the boss' level will not go up.
c. Nightmare requires a dedicated response token.
d. The boss' stamina gauge is displayed when the boss's strength is below 50%. By consuming the boss' stamina gauge, the boss slows down for a period of time and does not summon the enemy.
e. Boss effective weapon can consume the boss' stamina gauge faster.

9. October Combat Season Event
a. Period: October 1st ~ October 31st (September Combat season event completed on September 30th)
b. You can acquire Purple Hell equipment for the October Combat Season event.
c. You can earn rewards by acquiring experience points during the season.
d. You can obtain rewards for the Pro Pass by purchasing and using the Combat Pro Pass within the season.
e. The effect of the used Combat Pro Pass is valid for the duration of the season, and the effect ends when the season changes.
f. You can easily acquire Season EXP by purchasing and using Combat Season EXP items.

10. War Veteran ranking revised on the website.
a. The War Veteran ranking (Overall) that can be found on the website will be revised as follows.
b. Users with more rank reloads are ranked higher.
c. Among users of the same rank reload, users with higher EXP are ranked higher.
(Weekly and monthly War Veteran deals with the ranking of experiences acquired during that period, so the ranking is determined by the number of experiences acquired, not the number of rank reloads.)

11. Fire team Ultra Reward changed.
In the fire team ultra-difficulty level, repetitive rewards will be changed to a three-day item with an increase in duration from extreme.

12. Bugs fixed. 
a. When the Victory Run skill is activated, the bug that occurs have been fixed.
b. In Search & Destroy, a bug that does not work 6 key have been fixed.

13. October quest content updated.

14. October EXP/GP boost, hot time rewards, daily attendance rewards updated. 

15. October Premium Item updated.

16. Combat Week event removed
a. Removal of BSS GC Mileage 2x
b. Removal of the Fireteam Bonus Rewards
c. Removal of the Special Weapons in BSS and Shop
d. Removal of the Snowball Fight and Dead Vacation
e. Removal of the Combat Week Buff EXP / GP 300%

17. Ranking Zone New Season Begin
a. Ranking Zone rewards paid and new Ranking Zone season started (Period: September 29th ~ October 26th)

Push forward Rangers! Support is on its way for the entire week! Play on and take part in expansive bonuses we got in store just for you.[list]

[CHANGE LOGS]

4. EXP PASS 500% for sale (Sales period: September 1st ~ September 28th)
a. In commemoration of the Rank Reload System Update
b. Bonus EXP PASS (500%) 50% are sold.
c. Fast grow and experience ranking classes!

5. New mode added.
- New Mode Super Combat has been added.
- Super Combat is a mode that proceeds in order of three maps. All maps will be competed with two teams at the same time.
- First Map: Compete with your opponent team and kill NPCs. When the NPC is treated as much as the target count, a bonus stat is obtained.
- Second Map: A team that gave more damage to the boss can choose the skill you want during the additional skills presented. Damage less team will receive a different skill.
- Third map: Take advantage of the bonus stats and skills you have acquired so far, to treat your opponent as much as goal.

6. Enhance of Premium Pass Items
a. When the premium pass item is disassembled, it acquires a dedicated enhancement material.
b. You can enhance the premium pass item through its strengthening material.
c. Each premium pass item can be purchased once per premium pass-by-step basis.

7. Rank Reload System
a. When the highest level CIC5 is reached, you can pay 1.000.000 GP and reload the rank.
b. Reload rank and you will be a Traine again. 
c. The rank also shows how many times the rank is, and the rank color changes.
d. The required experience between classes has been adjusted with the addition of a rank reload system.
e. Promotional rewards have been changed and will be earned after reloading.

8. Fireteam improvement
a. Extra difficulty 'Ultra' added to the fireteam.
b. The harder the fire team's enemies are, the faster the movement will be.

9. Season Event Mode changed.
a. Seasonal event mode changed to Quarantine.
b. For the duration of the season, an EXP, GP 200% Boost will be added to the Quarantine.
c. During the season, you can transform into a strong zombie such as Crusher Mutagen and Striker Mutagen without purchasing items . (This may be changed later.)

10. Emotion Gesture System
a. Press the ''Z'' key and make the character do a special animation.
b. Use it to communicate with other players.

11. HOME & Clan UI Reorganization
a. Home screen and Clan UI have been reorganized to make it easier to see.

12. Nightmare Boss changed. 
a. Nightmare's boss will be changed to Subject X (Lv.80).
b. The more Nightmare's boss is defeated, the higher the boss's level and the more rewards change. However, if you defeat a boss who is lower than my boss level, the boss' level will not go up.
c. Nightmare requires a dedicated response token.
d. The boss' stamina gauge is displayed when the boss's strength is below 50%. By consuming the boss' stamina gauge, the boss slows down for a period of time and does not summon the enemy.
e. Boss effective weapon can consume the boss' stamina gauge faster.

13. September Combat Season Event
a. Period: September 1st ~ September 30th (August Combat season event completed on August 31st)
b. You can acquire Agent-Z equipment through the September Combat Season event. (Agent-Z character can use a dedicated skill turret master.)
c. You can earn rewards by acquiring experience points during the season.
d. You can obtain rewards for the Pro Pass by purchasing and using the Combat Pro Pass within the season.
e. The effect of the used Combat Pro Pass is valid for the duration of the season, and the effect ends when the season changes.
f. You can easily acquire Season EXP by purchasing and using Combat Season EXP items.

14. September quest content updated.

15. September EXP/GP boost, hot time rewards, daily attendance rewards updated. 

16. September Premium Item updated.

17. September exchange shop updated.

a. Clan Wars rewards paid and new Clan Wars season started (Period: September 1st ~ September 28th)

19. Ranking Zone New Season Begin
a. Ranking Zone rewards paid and new Ranking Zone season started (Period: September 1st ~ November 30th)

notes.title: Combat Arms Reloaded 2.0 Update
notes.content:
[h1]Combat Arms Reloaded 2.0[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33751039/b0b83967860e6839afe63dc9b86ff6db1981c378.jpg[/img]
[h2]SUPER COMBAT[/h2]
A mode similar to a triathlon where you can experience various modes of Combat Arms Reloaded at once.

First, the player will kill the infected person through the Fire Team match. What's different from the usual Fire team is that you get special abilities when you deal with infections and you divide them into teams. You will be able to achieve a variety of special abilities and perform more than usual. In addition, in the usual Fire team, if there was only a disturbance of the infection, the Super Combat would be directly interrupted by the enemy. Improve your ability by dealing with many infections, avoiding interference or interference from enemies.

When the Fire Team game is finished, the player enters the Nightmare Stage. Here, the player will kill the boss and acquire special skills as a compensation. This skill is more likely to be more than traditional character skills and can be used without a character. Nightmare is competing as a team to compete with the team, the team gave more damage than the opponent team will have a skill priority option.

Players who have all the abilities they've gained to compete in the final alimony match will face off in the final arena. All of the preceding courses are for this time and the team that achieves the target enemy number in the last game will be the final winner of the Super Combat.
Use the various tactics from Combat Arms Reloaded to lead your team to victory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33751039/96a680fe49f9be8250d5e48462c73239847b8a9d.jpg[/img]
[h2]RANK RELOAD[/h2]
Playing is exciting, yes, right!?, due to the fact that you can get rewards as you rank up your account, but for those who are already at the top of their game, it is a different story. This is why Combat Arms Reloaded is shaking up things a bit by enticing players that they can earn additional rewards by reloading their max ranks repeatedly.

[h2]PREMIUM ITEM UPDATE[/h2]
1. Premium Pass Improvement Overview[list]
[*] Delete Premium Pass Shop
[*] Added premium pass item enhancement
[*] Purchase past premium pass items
[/list]
2. Delete Premium Pass Shop[list]
[*] Remove the premium pass store from the store menu.
[*] As usual, premium passes are available on the Features tab.
[*] Premium pass users will receive items their equipment tabs when they start using them and register new premium items.
[/list]
3. Added premium pass item enhancement[list]
[*] Premium pass items can now be enhanced and used.
[*] By selling unused premium pass items, you can get premium item reinforcement materials according to your grade.
[*] Regardless of the item type, you can enhance it by using the same grade of materials.
[*] It is impossible to enhanced using the same item.
[*] If you sell premium pass items, you cannot get them again, so you need to be careful.
[/list]
4. Purchase past premium pass items[list]
[*] You can now purchase past premium pass items.
[*] You can purchase past premium pass items on an added basis.
[*] You can purchase past premium pass items once for each account.
[*] Purchase restrictions are calculated after the update and are independent of existing premium pass items.
[*] Past premium pass items can be purchased by pressing the button in the inventory.
[*] Only premium pass users can purchase past premium pass items.
[*] Premium pass items can only be used by premium pass users. (Same as before)
[/list]
[h2]Lobby UI Update[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33751039/65f38e5de34879aed6406c25292d60cb195ba541.png[/img]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33751039/bf216586635dcef08a625af656b01afd6f2071d6.jpg[/img]

[h1]Combat Week[/h1]
[h3]Event Period (08/18 ~ 08/24)[/h3]

Push forward Rangers! Support is on its way for the entire week! Play on and take part in expansive bonuses we got in store just for you.[list]

notes.title: DEVELOPERS' BRIEFING - 08.02
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33751039/c7d0f95397424552b8e962bacd9957998c5dce85.png[/img]

Greetings to our Combat Arms Rangers!
This is the development team leader of Combat Arms: Reloaded.
It's the beginning of summer here. The summer temperature seems to be increasing more and more.
I heard that abnormal weather occurs frequently all over the world, so please take good care of your health.

On May 26th, the 4th-anniversary event started with the addition of a new mode due to the summer season.
The new mode is a solo battle mode in which players compete with each other for gold bars (GP) appearing on the map in the hunted map for the purpose of acquiring GP.
In case of death, some of the GP acquired in-game may be dropped and taken away, but you can also prevent the drop by sending GP through an object in a specific location.
In addition, a 'GP jackpot system' has been added that allows you to multiply the GP rewards of the new mode according to the accumulated multiplier in proportion to the number of times you play other modes.
We expect a lot of participation from users who usually thought that GP was insufficient.

In celebration of the 4th anniversary of the opening, various events have been prepared as follows.
- Event exchange shop (event metal paid according to playtime)
- 40 games play clear and special weekly mission for 4 weeks
- 400% EXP/GP boost 
- Nutshot Ranking Event

Meanwhile, in mid-June, the special weapon enhancement stage is extended with the addition of special weapons.
In particular, the 'laser gun' is a gun with penetrating characteristics and will be a very effective weapon against opponents with high defense.
After that, in late June, we are preparing to improve the Premium Pass.
Premium items can now be enhanced, and you can purchase and use premium items from the past month.
We want to improve the overall system in the future, so we need your continued interest and support. ^^

We will always strive to do our best in order to bring a better game experience for everyone.
Thank you.

notes.title: Patch Notes 2021.06.30
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33751039/19053738b10cfc4fbfd274ace23887f6ab26b0d5.jpg[/img]

[CHANGE LOGS]
1.Server Stability

2.MA COMPENSATION
a. 200% EXP & GP Boost for 2021.06.30 Maintenance for the rest of the day.
b. Functional Metal 100 pcs
c. Nightmare Respawn Token 15 Pcs (1 day)
•NOTE: MA Compensation can only be obtained on the day of MA

3. New item released (Sale Period: June 30th ~July 27th)
>Scorpion Soldier Gear Mystery Box
a. Scorpion Soldier Gear Mystery Box
b. Scorpion Soldier Gear Mystery Box x5
c. Scorpion Soldier Gear Mystery Box x10
•NOTE: If you buy the x10, 1 permanent item is guaranteed.
>Scorpion Soldier Gear Package (Sale Period: June 30th ~July 27th)
a. Scorpion Soldier Vest
b. Scorpion Soldier Mask
c. Scorpion Soldier Beanie
Note 2: Equip the new gears. Play game. You can acquire weapon metals. (June 30th ~July 27th).

4. Special weapon mystery box's pick-up box added.
a. Pick-up count will be added to the Special Weapon mystery box.
b. If you are satisfied with the pick-up count, you will receive a pick-up box that can permanently acquire the special weapon you want permanently.

5. New accessories and strengthen accessory items added
a.The performance of accessories that give EXP and GP bonuses has been enhanced.
b. In addition, 5 new accessories have been added.
Golden Heart Dogtag: EXP +120%
Golden Crown Coin: GP +120%
Picture of Pet: Effect of 4 pieces of equipment on WEAPON METAL acquisition function (equipment)
Bronze Knife Decoration: EXP/GP +15%
Bronze Grenade Decoration: EXP/GP +20%
6. BattlEye Update
a. In the previous survey, ''players using hacking tools'' were found to be the most problematic in the game.
b. After an internal discussion, the security tool of Combat Arms Reloaded was changed from Nprotect to BattlEye.

7. Nightmare Boss Changed
a. Nightmare's boss will be changed to Violent Captain (Lv.70).
b. The more Nightmare's boss is defeated, the higher the boss's level and the more rewards change. However, if you defeat a boss who is lower than my boss level, the boss' level will not go up.
c. Nightmare requires a dedicated response token.
d. The boss' stamina gauge is displayed when the boss's strength is below 50%. By consuming the boss' stamina gauge, the boss slows down for a period of time and does not summon the enemy.
e. Boss effective weapon can consume the boss' stamina gauge faster.

8. July Combat Season
Event Period: July 1st - July 31st (June Combat Season Event is completed on June 30th)
a. You can acquire Mummy equipment through the July Combat Season event.
b. You can earn rewards by acquiring experience points during the season.
c. You can obtain rewards for the Pro Pass by purchasing and using the Combat Pro Pass within the season.
d. The effect of the used Combat Pro Pass is valid for the duration of the season, and the effect ends when the season changes.
e. You can easily acquire Season EXP by purchasing and using Combat Season EXP items.

9. VIP Pass Attendance Item Improvement
a. The attendance items paid with the VIP pass have been improved.

10. BattlEye application commemorative enhancement event
Duration: June 30th ~July 28th
a. The amount of enhancement materials required to enhance rare/epic grade weapons and gears is reduced.
b. You can obtain enhancement materials when disassembling rare/epic grade weapons and gear permanents.

11. Combat Week event removed
a. Removal of the Combat Week event
b. Removal of BSS GC Mileage 2x
c. Removal of the Fireteam Bonus Rewards
d. Removal of the Special Weapons in BSS and Shop
e. Removal of the Snowball Fight and Dead Vacation
f. Removal of the Combat Week Buff EXP / GP 200%

12. July Quest content updated.

13. July EXP/GP boost, hot time rewards, daily attendance rewards updated.

14. July Premium Item updated.

15.Clan Wars New Season Begin
a. Clan Wars rewards paid and new Clan Wars season started (Period: June 30th ~July 28th)

16. July EXP/GP Event

notes.title: [NOTICE] Security Update Event - BattlEye
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33751039/fd2734b7009c8d137bfcc3469e8aca89a42fa786.jpg[/img]

[h2]Combat Arms: Reloaded Security Tool Update[/h2]

Good news, Rangers!

This is Combat Arms Reloaded development team.

In the results of the previous survey, the opinion that the game was difficult because of hacking users overwhelmingly took first place.

Therefore, after much discussion, our development team has decided to change the security tool of Combat Arms Reloaded to Battle Eye, which is known as the most effective anti-cheat tool.

Battle Eye will be applied on [b][u]June 30, 2021[/u][/b], so we hope that you will enjoy playing the game more.

Also, please note that we are holding an enhancement event to commemorate the enhancement of the Battle Eye security tool.
[olist]
[*] Reduced the amount of enhancement materials required to enhance rare and epic items.
[*] Enhancement materials can be obtained when disassembling rare and epic permanent items.(Permanent items with a lot of enhancement will acquire more enhancement materials)
[*] All enhancements cost 0 GP.
[/olist]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33751039/19053738b10cfc4fbfd274ace23887f6ab26b0d5.jpg[/img]

[h1][CHANGE LOGS][/h1]
[h3]1.Server Stability

2.MA COMPENSATION[/h3][list]
a. Function Metal 100 pcs
b. Nightmare Respawn Token 15pcs (1 day usage)
•NOTE: MA Compensation can only be obtained on the day of MA[/list]
[h3]3. New item released (Sale Period: 05.26 ~ 06.29)[/h3][list]
a. Horus Mystery Box 
b. Horus Mystery Box  x5
c. Horus Mystery Box  x10
•NOTE: If you buy the x10, 1 permanent item is guaranteed.

[h3]d. Horus Gear Package (Sale Period: 05.26 ~ 06.02)[/h3]
e. Horus Vest
f. Horus Helmet
g. Horus Backpack
Note 2: Equip the new gears. Play game. You can acquire weapon metals.  (until ~6.29).[/list]
[h3]4. Increase the number of enhance item purchases by grade (untill ~6.29)[/h3][list]
a. During the event, the quantity of Rare, Epic, and Legendary enhancement material items is doubled.[/list]
[h3]5. New Mode: GP Rush[/h3][list]
a. The new mode GP Rush opened.
b. GP Rush is a mode in which GP is acquired by picking up a GP from a map.
c. When you kill an opponent, the GP he or she has drops at a certain rate.
d. Operating the device at the top of the mountain allows the GP to be transferred to a safe place.
e. GP Rush does not have a GP base reward and will earn a GP and have it as a reward.
f. GP Rush does not apply EXP/GP Boost by various GP Boosts and items.[/list]
[h3]6. GP Jackpot System[/h3][list]
a. When you play the game, your GP Jackpot rate will accumulate up to 1000%.
b. If the accumulated GP Jackpot ratio exceeds 500%, GP Jackpot may occur when the GP Rush mode ends.
c. When a GP Jackpot occurs, the GP earned in GP Rush is multiplied by the GP Jackpot ratio, so you can get a lot of GP.
d. GP Jackpot occurs once a day.[/list]
[h3]7. Nightmare Boss changed.[/h3][list]
a. The Nightmare boss is changed to subject X (Lv.70).
b. The more you defeat the Nightmare boss, the higher the level of the boss, and the higher the reward. However, if you defeat a boss that is lower than my boss level, the boss level will not go up.
c. Nightmare requires a dedicated response token.
d. When the boss' strength falls below 50%, the stamina gauge of the boss is displayed. If you consume the boss' stamina gauge, the boss will grow for a while.
e. Boss special weapons allow you to consume the boss' stamina gauge faster.[/list]
[h3]8. June Combat Season Event[/h3][list]
a. Period: 6.1~6.30 (May Combat Season Event completed 5.31)
b. Blue Skull equipment can be acquired for June Combat season events.
c. You can earn rewards by gaining experience during the season.
d. Purchasing and using a Combat Pro pass within the season will help you earn rewards for the Pro pass.
e. The effect of the used Combat Process is valid for the duration of the season, and the effect ends when the season changes.
f. If you purchase and use the Combat Season EXP item, you can easily gain season experience.[/list]
[h3]9. Combat Arms Reloaded 4th Anniversary Event (Period: 5.26~6.29)[/h3][list]
a. 4th anniversary metal, 1 in 2 minutes.
b. Exchange shop can exchange items
c. Nutshot Ranking Event started.
d. Special Weekly Quest added
e. 4th Anniversary EXP GP Boost (same weekends and weekdays)
- 400 % (5.26~6.22)
- 500 % (6.23~6.29)[/list]
[h3]10. Summer Season Starts[/h3][list]
a. The summer season started.  (from 5.26 to 8.31)
b. Seasonal Event Mode changed.
c. The event mode of the spring season is GP Rush.
d. Seasonal event mode adds a 200% EXP bonus.
e. Ranking Zone rewards paid and new season started[/list]
[h3]11. Other updates[/h3][list]
a. June Quests Content updated
b .June EXP/GP boost, hot time rewards, daily attendance rewards updated. 
c. June Premium items updated.
d. June Exchange Shop Item updated.
e. Clan Wars rewards paid and new Clan Wars season started (Period: 5.26 ~ 6.29)
f. Combat Week event removed[/list]
[h3]12. June EXP/GP Event[/h3][list]
2021-05-26 00:00 ~ 2021-06-22 23:59 : 4th Anniversary Boost (400% EXP / 400% GP)
2021-06-23 00:00 ~ 2021-06-29 23:59 : 4th Anniversary Boost (500% EXP / 500% GP)[/list]

notes.title: DEVELOPERS' BRIEFING - 05.31
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33751039/c7d0f95397424552b8e962bacd9957998c5dce85.png[/img]

Greetings to our Combat Arms Rangers!
This is the development team leader of Combat Arms: Reloaded.
It's the beginning of summer here. The summer temperature seems to be increasing more and more.
I heard that abnormal weather occurs frequently all over the world, so please take good care of your health.


On May 26th, the 4th-anniversary event started with the addition of a new mode due to the summer season.
The new mode is a solo battle mode in which players compete with each other for gold bars (GP) appearing on the map in the hunted map for the purpose of acquiring GP.
In case of death, some of the GP acquired in-game may be dropped and taken away, but you can also prevent the drop by sending GP through an object in a specific location.
In addition, a 'GP jackpot system' has been added that allows you to multiply the GP rewards of the new mode according to the accumulated multiplier in proportion to the number of times you play other modes.
We expect a lot of participation from users who usually thought that GP was insufficient.


In celebration of the 4th anniversary of the opening, various events have been prepared as follows.
- Event exchange shop (event metal paid according to playtime)
- 40 games play clear and special weekly mission for 4 weeks
- 400% EXP/GP boost 
- Nutshot Ranking Event


Meanwhile, in mid-June, the special weapon enhancement stage is extended with the addition of special weapons.
In particular, the 'laser gun' is a gun with penetrating characteristics and will be a very effective weapon against opponents with high defense.
After that, in late June, we are preparing to improve the Premium Pass.
Premium items can now be enhanced, and you can purchase and use premium items from the past month.
We want to improve the overall system in the future, so we need your continued interest and support. ^^


We will always strive to do our best in order to bring a better game experience for everyone.
Thank you.

Premium items can now be enhanced, and you can purchase and use premium items from the past month.

Rangers!

Combat Arms: Reloaded will undergo emergency maintenance with a 1-hour downtime. During the emergency maintenance access to the game will be temporarily blocked. Head over to our official channels for further updates.

27/05/2021 07:00 UTC / 27/05/2021 09:00 CEST / 27/04/2021 00:00 PDT.

1. An issue in Nightmare's EXP and GP rewards seen 0 has been fixed.
2. An issue where the respawn tokens could not be used on some maps of Fire Team has been fixed.
3. An issue where the GP Jackpot UI was not displayed when the game ends normally has been fixed.

[h3][MAINTENANCE COMPENSATION][/h3]

> Nightmare Respawn Token 15 pcs (1 day usage)

Thank you for your unwavering support for Combat Arms: Reloaded!

a. During the event, the quantity of Rare, Epic, and Legendary enhancement material items is doubled.[/list]
[h3]5. New Mode: GP Rush[/h3][list]
a. The new mode GP Rush opened.
b. GP Rush is a mode in which GP is acquired by picking up a GP from a map.
c. When you kill an opponent, the GP he or she has drops at a certain rate.
d. Operating the device at the top of the mountain allows the GP to be transferred to a safe place.
e. GP Rush does not have a GP base reward and will earn a GP and have it as a reward.
f. GP Rush does not apply EXP/GP Boost by various GP Boosts and items.[/list]
[h3]6. GP Jackpot System[/h3][list]
a. When you play the game, your GP Jackpot rate will accumulate up to 1000%.
b. If the accumulated GP Jackpot ratio exceeds 500%, GP Jackpot may occur when the GP Rush mode ends.
c. When a GP Jackpot occurs, the GP earned in GP Rush is multiplied by the GP Jackpot ratio, so you can get a lot of GP.
d. GP Jackpot occurs once a day.[/list]
[h3]7. Nightmare Boss changed.[/h3][list]
a. The Nightmare boss is changed to subject X (Lv.70).
b. The more you defeat the Nightmare boss, the higher the level of the boss, and the higher the reward. However, if you defeat a boss that is lower than my boss level, the boss level will not go up.
c. Nightmare requires a dedicated response token.
d. When the boss' strength falls below 50%, the stamina gauge of the boss is displayed. If you consume the boss' stamina gauge, the boss will grow for a while.
e. Boss special weapons allow you to consume the boss' stamina gauge faster.[/list]
[h3]8. June Combat Season Event[/h3][list]
a. Period: 6.1~6.30 (May Combat Season Event completed 5.31)
b. Blue Skull equipment can be acquired for June Combat season events.
c. You can earn rewards by gaining experience during the season.
d. Purchasing and using a Combat Pro pass within the season will help you earn rewards for the Pro pass.
e. The effect of the used Combat Process is valid for the duration of the season, and the effect ends when the season changes.
f. If you purchase and use the Combat Season EXP item, you can easily gain season experience.[/list]
[h3]9. Combat Arms Reloaded 4th Anniversary Event (Period: 5.26~6.29)[/h3][list]

- 500 % (6.23~6.29)[/list]
[h3]10. Summer Season Starts[/h3][list]
a. The summer season started.  (from 5.26 to 8.31)
b. Seasonal Event Mode changed.
c. The event mode of the spring season is GP Rush.
d. Seasonal event mode adds a 200% EXP bonus.
e. Ranking Zone rewards paid and new season started[/list]
[h3]11. Other updates[/h3][list]
a. June Quests Content updated
b .June EXP/GP boost, hot time rewards, daily attendance rewards updated. 
c. June Premium items updated.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33751039/82df4aa783d9b56f6a2e636aa645fa6d393ff578.png[/img]

[h2][CHANGE LOGS][/h2]
[h3]1.Server Stability

2.MA COMPENSATION[/h3]
a. 200% EXP & GP Boost for 2021.04.28 Maintenance for the rest of the day.
b. Function Metal 100 pcs
c. Nightmare Respawn Token 15pcs (1 day usage)
•NOTE: MA Compensation can only be obtained on the day of MA

[h3]3. New item released (Sale Period: 04.28 ~ 05.25)[/h3]
a. Powered Armor Mystery Box
b. Powered Armor Mystery Box x5
c. Powered Armor Mystery Box x10
•NOTE: If you buy the x10, 1 permanent item is guaranteed.

d. Powered Armor Gear Package (Sale Period: 04.28 ~ 05.25)
e. Cyborg Scarlet
f. Powered Armor Vest
g. Powered Armor Helmet
h. Powered Armor Backpack

Note 2: Equip the new character or gears. Play game. You can acquire weapon metals. (until ~5/25).
Note 3: When using the new character Cyborg Scarlet, you can proceed with the character quest. (Until ~5/25)
Note 4: Equip the Powered Armor Gear series to more effectively defend against the attacks of Nightmare's Master-Z.

[h3]4. Character Skills EXP Item Released[/h3]
a. When used for a character (permanent), items are released to add the character's skill EXP.

[h3]5. Nightmare 3rd Boss Officially Open and Boss Damage Event started.[/h3]
a. The 3rd boss is officially open in Nightmare.
b. Boss damage event starts until 25th May
c. As the boss of Nightmare is defeated, the level of the boss increases and the reward changes. However, if you defeat a boss with a level lower than your boss level, the boss level will not increase.
d. The maximum level of the boss in the full version is 60.
e. Nightmare requires a dedicated respawn token.
f. The attack of the 3rd boss has a lot of bullet attacks. Equipment with high defense is advantageous for attack.
g. Nightmare level up rewards and boss defeat rewards have been slightly increased.

[h3]6. Combat Season Event in May[/h3]
Period: May 1-May 31 (April Combat Season Event will be completed on April 30)
a. Forest Warfare equipment can be acquired through the Combat Season Event in May.
b. You can earn rewards by earning experience points during the season.
c. Purchase and use the Combat Pro Pass within the season to earn rewards for the Pro Pass.
d. The effect of the Combat Pro Pass used is valid for the duration of the season, and the effect ends when the season changes.
e. You can easily acquire Season EXP by purchasing and using Combat Season EXP items.

[h3]7. Weekly monthly quest added[/h3]
a. In addition to daily quests, weekly and monthly quests are added.

[h3]8. Character Enhancement Level Expansion[/h3]
a. In the case of characters, it is now possible to upgrade to Normal: +6, Rare: +7, Epic: +8, and Legendary: +9.

[h3]9. Clan Wars New Season Begin[/h3]
a. Clan Wars rewards paid and new Clan Wars season started (Period: 4.28 ~ 5.25)

[h3]10. Combat Week event removed[/h3]
a. Removal of the Combat Week event
b. Removal of BSS GC Mileage 2x
c. Removal of the Fireteam Bonus Rewards
d. Removal of the Special Weapons in BSS and Shop
e. Removal of the Snowball Fight and Dead Vacation
f. Removal of the Combat Week Buff EXP / GP 300%
[h3]
11. May daily jobs updated.

12. May EXP/GP boost, hot time rewards, daily attendance rewards updated.

13. Premium items updated

14. Bug fixes[/h3]
a. An issue that could not be achieved on the 5th, 6th, and 7th day of the 7 Days (New User Exclusive) event that occurred after February 24, 2021 has been fixed.
b. Days 5, 6 and 7 rewards will be given to new users who signed up from February 24 to April 27, 2021
c. Day 5, 6, 7 Reward: CZ805 Tsunami, M249 Para Lava Works, Diesel punk Mask, 110000GP, CLAN METAL +750, GENERAL METAL +900

[h3]15. May EXP/GP Event[/h3]

notes.content:

[CHANGELOGS]

4. Sales of RARE-level items
a. You can purchase RARE-grade items in the shop.
b. SMG, Pistol, Support, and characters will be on sale (until 3/31).



5. Overall game rewards and exchange shop reorganization
- The metal used at the exchange shop will no longer be available at the exchange shop.
- Those who own the existing metal can exchange it for new metal at each exchange shop.


a. Functional Metal
- Functional metal can exchange various functional items.
- You can earn a certain number of times each day through Fire Team and AI (Bot) match.

b. Gear metal
- Gear metal can be exchanged for gear items of each grade.
- You can earn it when you level up on Nightmare and when you play Nightmare.

c. Weapon metal
- Weapon metal can be exchanged for weapon items of each grade.
- You can earn it by playing the Clan Wars and Ranking matches.
- You can earn it when you play the game for a certain period of time after wearing the newly released item. 
- You can earn it if you buy and have VIP item. VIP pass users can get weapon metal instead of rare metal.


d. Character metal
- Character metal can be exchanged for character items for each grade.
- You can earn it when using content such as daily job and attendance.

In addition to the guide, you can get new metals by replacing existing old metals.


e. Hot time items
- Starting from March's hot time, we will give 20 gear metals for each hot time on weekdays, 20 each on weekends, and 100 gear metals for maintenance.


6. <Start of spring season>
- The spring season starts from 2/24 to 5/26.

a. Season event mode change
- The event mode for the spring season is Search & Destroy.
- 200% EXP/GP bonus is added to the Seasonal Event mode.

b. Search & Destroy content improvement
- The contents of Search & Destroy are improved by one of the attacking team members picking up a bomb and carrying the bomb to install a bomb.

c. Ranking zone reward payment and new season started.



7. <Nightmare Violent Runaway Captain Officially Open>
a. The Nightmare record and the level of the Violent Runaway Captain during the beta period resetted.
b. Nightmare Violent Runaway Captain's level has been raised to a maximum of 60.
c. The EXP/GP reward for the violent captain has been increased.
d. Nightmare personal records have been added.
e. Nightmare achievements have been added.
f. Nightmare EXP/GP 100% will be maintained in March.
g. The SCS gear can more effectively defend against the attack of the violent captain.

h. Nightmare Boss Damage Event  (Event period: 2.24 ~ 3.31)
In Nightmare, the boss damage event that competes for the ranks with the damage attacked by the boss violent captain begins.
Rewards are paid according to the daily ranking and overall ranking during the event period.
Attacking a boss with a high level is advantageous for ranking competition.


8. Clan Wars New Season Begin
a. Clan Wars rewards paid and new Clan Wars season started (Period: 2.24 ~ 3.31)

9. March EXP cumulative event starts
Period: 2.24 ~ 3.31

10. Premium item updated

11. Bugs fixed 
a. Siren skill HUD disappearing bug have been fixed.
b. Duplicated Free Weapons in the equipment tab bug have been fixed. 
c. Options keybind not saving bug have been fixed.

notes.title: Nightmare Boss 2 Beta Launch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33751039/ecfcb8f161f14809bf323b9b4e7866a6e3bf27fa.jpg[/img]
[list]
[i]Attention!

We shall be conducting an incursion on a rogue Nemexis cruise liner believed to house a research lab that caused an outbreak on-board. Operators are to exercise caution during the mission against all hostiles as they are suspected to be carrying a high-infectious mutagen. A scout JSF team and a few civilians are trapped below deck and can only be rescued with our help.
Our mission is to eliminate all hostiles from bow-to-stern, sweep for any stragglers as we make way, and seize command of the ship from whoever or whatever is on the helm. Once in control of the vessel, it will be redirected away from any population centers to avoid any further contamination.

This is not an easy task but you are the best of the best! You are Rangers!

Hoo~ah![/i]
[/list]
[h3][b]Nightmare Boss 2 Beta[/b][/h3]

Take part in a frantic, claustrophobic boss battle featuring the 2nd Nightmare Boss known as the “Violent Mutant Captain”.

[list]1.	The 2nd Nightmare Boss will run as a beta release.

2.	This new boss comes in with new tricks up its sleeve that will surely engage our players in exhilarating boss battles.

3.	Progression is similar to the 1st Nightmare Boss, wherein defeating more bosses and higher-Level bosses earns you the chance of getting more rewards. Additionally, beating bosses that have lower levels than what you currently attain will not increase your current boss level. This means you’ll be able to help your friends and clanmates catch up to your Boss Level.

4.	As with the Beta Release format, the maximum level achievable is capped at Level 50.

5.	The Nightmare mode is a very challenging game mode that entails the unforeseen “death” during battle. However, you can respawn back to the match by using Nightmare Respawn Tokens or ask your friend to revive you using a Nightmare Party Respawn Token.

6.	As teased in the Nightmare story introduction, The entire stage is pretty much contaminated and brings a lot of damage-over-time which is why suiting up in gear with high gas with protection is highly recommended.

7.	To give a little extra boost to our Beta Launch Participants. They’ll be receiving an additional 100% EX / GP Bonus for playing Nightmare Boss 2 Beta
[/list]

notes.title: DEVELOPERS' BRIEFING #26
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33751039/c7d0f95397424552b8e962bacd9957998c5dce85.png[/img]

Greetings to our Combat Arms Rangers!

This is the development team leader of Combat Arms: Reloaded.

 The tough year of 2020 has come to a close and although we are just a few days into the new year, 2021, it seems that plans for gatherings and celebrations would have to wait a little bit more. 

Yet still for 2021, I sincerely hope that soon, it will possible again for everyone to get back to their daily activities and mingle with others like before.

Then again, in behalf of the Combat Arms Reloaded Team, we’d like to thank all our players that stuck out with us even with the troubles of 2020. Let’s all share the sense of optimism for this new year! 

Now, let’s crack on the Developer’s Briefing.

As the saying goes, “Save the best for last” and for our last update of 2020. We surely did!

On the December 30th Update, we’ve included several very note-worthy content. Namely, the official launch of the Nightmare Mode’s first Boss, the introduction of the Advanced Mystery Boxes and Item Shop revamp.

The official launch of the 1st Nightmare Boss to the game has brought in some updates to game mode. Here are top notable updates with regards the official launch:

1.	Maximum Nightmare Boss Level has been increased to 60. Additionally, a new type of NPC will spawn upon reaching Boss Lv.51.
2.	Rewards are now given to the top participant, stage clear reward and mission achievement reward.
3.	In line with the official launch, we’ve also rolled out a damage record ranking event.

As mentioned on previous Developer Briefings, we brought in some quality-of-life improvements as well introducing the Advance Mystery Boxes.

1.	Added a milestone reward system from accumulated purchases of a selected Advanced Mystery Box. The Milestone reward box allows the player to select a desired item of a similar type.
2.	In celebration of the update, a “Pickup Collection X2 Event” scheduled to be added soon.
3.	The Item Shop Revamp now offers a wider selection of Rare-grade items and has removed common items from availability.

Capping off the review of the updates we’ve rolled-out in the last part of 2020. We’d like to briefly share some general concepts with regards our content development for 2021.

We are planning to continue the addition of more content for the Nightmare mode. We are currently developing the second boss for the Nightmare Mode and adding in a third boss is being considered.

In addition to more types of Nightmare Bosses, we plan on implementing a combat season wherein players can fight against different Nightmare Bosses on a three-month period, each season. 

To add a bit of challenge to the Nightmare mode, the bosses’ maximum level will increase each season then gaining new boss skills or encounter new enemy NPCs in succeeding levels.

Since we are amping up the challenges available to our players, we’ll be buffing you up as well. We are currently planning to develop more specialized equipment. 

These specialized equipment provide extra stats that will come in handy for specific situations, the current primary focus for theses items are Specialized equipment for the Nightmare mode.

Lastly, we have more plans of adding a healthy variety of content that is sure to peak your interests. I hope that more and more user join as these inspire us to give out more content.

We will always strive to do our best in order to bring a better game experience for everyone.

Thank you.

notes.title: DEVELOPERS' BRIEFING #25
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33751039/c7d0f95397424552b8e962bacd9957998c5dce85.png[/img]

Greetings to our Combat Arms Rangers!

This is the development team leader of Combat Arms: Reloaded.

It is only a few days left until the close of 2020 and most areas of the world are still struggling with the effects of the CoVID-19 pandemic. 2020 wasn't kind year for everyone and we hope that our has shared some form of relief to our players. In behalf of our entire team, I can't thank you enough for the continued support for Combat Arms: Reloaded throughout these trying times.

To wrap up 2020 in a happy and uplifting note, let's begin our developer's briefing.

Last November 25th, The Nightmare Match (Boss Match) debuted in its BETA version after some serious development process. As it is still in the BETA phase, we are continuously making adjustments and tweaks that will improve the overall playthrough experience for this mode. 

We know that there are certain aspects of the game mode that felt incomplete however, the BETA launch is an effort to fulfill a promise to our player base to deliver a different twist in the current Combat Arms experience.

I do apologize that since the Nightmare Mode is still in its BETA Phase, we are still in the period of collecting and comparing all the data from those that played Nightmare in order for us to address concerns such as bugs and difficultly adjustments. We encourage our players to try out and play the Nightmare Mode more frequently as each match played, regardless of the result, will help in improving the gaming experience.

I think that the BETA Phase is necessary to provide a fantastic opportunity for everyone interested or otherwise curious about the newly added feature. We are doing our very best complete the BETA phase and fully release Nightmare mode.

I'm sorry for several inconveniences that had been put in place in order to address issues such as bug fixes and difficulty adjustments. 

On our December 1 Update, we've delivered on our promise to add more quality of life improvements to Combat Arms: Reloaded in the form of UI changes incorporating Quick Play as well as the Daily Quest button which have been added to the Home Screen.

These quality of life improvements are aimed to lessen idle time and increase playtime. Firstly, we added very intuitive UI changes in accessing Quick Play for both Daily Quests and Event Modes. Moreover, we've made some Daily Quest Improvements which expanded the variety of available daily quests as well as the ability to progress more missions simultaneously.

The update also includes our grand Christmas celebration event scheduled to go for 25 days that started last December 1st and is to close on December 25th. The season is all about sharing and giving, so we've dropped in some generous treat for all our players.

- Get rewards worth 5000 GC from the Special EXP Accumulation Event.
- Wear your Christmas Items and gather rare metal from doing all sorts of activities in-game.
- From 100% up to 300% EXP and GP Boosts for all 25-days of the Event.
- The season's fashion pick is Santa hats now worn not only by NPCs but the Fireteam Zombies as well.

In order to top off every news and recap we've done so far; we are proud to announce that we are currently in development of the next Nightmare match map which hopefully is ready for early access by the end of January 2021.

As previously mentioned, we couldn't have done it past this troubling year without your kind and continued support. We are doing our very best to further improve the game experience and introduce more interesting content not just for next year but for the coming years. ^^

I will again take this opportunity to thank all our players, new or veterans, as your enthusiasm and support keeps us motivated to give the best gaming experience possible.

We will always strive to do our best in order to bring a better game experience for everyone.

Thank you.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33751039/17bff60aec4eb0d853ea7135f0286ac9530e3234.png[/img]

Rangers!

Combat Arms: Reloaded will emergency maintenance is extended by 1 hour. 

During the emergency maintenance access to the game will be temporarily blocked. Head over to our official channels for further updates.

[list][b]Current:[/b]
i.e.: Player A = Boss Lvl 5; Player B = Boss Lvl 3; Player C = Boss Lvl 8; Player D = Boss Lvl 5
Player A joins and defeat boss from Player B room = No Change
Player A joins and defeat boss from Player C room = No Change  
Player A joins and defeat boss from Player D room = No Change 

[b]Change:[/b]
i.e.: Player A = Boss Lvl 5; Player B = Boss Lvl 3; Player C = Boss Lvl 8; Player D = Boss Lvl 5

Player A joins and defeat boss from Player D room = +1 Boss Level for Player A
[/list]
3. Fix an issue when sending a 1+1 item as a gift, a warning message indicating that the 1+1 event does not apply.
[/list]
Thank you for your unwavering support for Combat Arms: Reloaded!

notes.title: Nightmare Mode
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33751039/4fe4dae1ea1e1038d95077623153287088adce13.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]New Nightmare Mode (Beta Release)[/b][/h3]
[i]Code: Red!!!  

Code: Red!!!

Containment has been breached. Hostiles sighted are massive bio-mechanical hybrids equipped with very powerful augmented weaponry. Operators are to proceed with the mission and neutralize the threat. 

Rangers! Give’em hell!

Move~out![/i]

[list][b]Nightmare[/b] is new co-op game mode that allows participants to challenge power bosses with coordinated maneuvers and team-based tactics. Bosses deal massive amounts of damage and eliciting the help its minions which adds another layer of challenge for the game mode. The Combat Area plays an extensive role in the encounter as it is both riddled with obstacles while providing cover spots that can save you on those tricky engagements.

Unlike other game modes, the access to the Nightmare Mode is limited to set number which recovers over a period of time.

Successfully defeating a Boss will raise Boss’ Level and better the quality of the rewards that can be received. The higher the level of the boss, the more powerful it becomes and better rewards challengers can receive. 

The Boss’ Level in the room will depend on the Room Master’s highest reached Boss Level.

Clearing another player's room with an equal or higher-level Boss will increase current Boss Level by 1. Additionally, The highest attained Boss Level will reset at the end of each season.

Participants that die in combat, can revive themselves by using Nightmare Respawn Tokens or by the aid of their ally with the use of the Nightmare Party Respawn Tokens.
[/list]

[b]Nightmare Mode (Beta Release) Mechanics[/b]

a.	Nightmare mode has a set number of challenges and this number is restored over time.

b.	Defeating a Nightmare Boss will increase its Level. The increase in Level will increase difficulty while providing better rewards.
[list]i.	Highest attained Nightmare Boss Level will increase by 1 after clearing another player’s Nightmare Match if the Boss’ Level equal or higher than currently attained. 
ii.	The Boss’ Level in the room will depend on the Room Host’s highest attained Boss Level
iii.	The highest attained Boss Level will reset at the end of each season.
[/list]
c.	The maximum level of the Nightmare Boss for the Beta Version release is Level 50.

d.	Reviving yourself or a teammate in the new Nightmare Mode requires use of either the Nightmare respawn token or the Nightmare Party Respawn ticket.

e.	[b]Map Info: Nightmare Mode - Subject X[/b]
[list][b]a.	Boss Info: Subject X[/b] is ruthless bio-mechanical hybrid that broke out in rampage in the underground facilities of TEC’s Antarctic Secret Lab.
[list]i.	[b]Offense: Stomp[/b] – Area of Effect extreme close-range attack.
ii.	[b]Offense: Rush – Close[/b] in distance attack; Boss runs toward a target.
iii.	[b]Offense: Gatling Strafe[/b] – Boss fires in the general direction of where the most number of players are gathered.
iv.	[b]Offense: Gatling Aimed[/b] – fires a continuous barrage towards the direction any player in the match
[/list]
[b]b.	Minions[/b]
[list]i.	[b]Frostbite Zombies[/b] – slow attack speed; low damage. However, they tend to block key areas that can provide cover against the Boss’ burst damage. Also, drops ammo boxes and medkits.
[/list]
[b]c.	Stage[/b]
[list]i.	[b]Frost[/b] – deals damage over time to players going towards the center of the map; also, hinder range of vision on prolonged exposure.
[/list][/list]
[b]New Items added for Nightmare mode (Beta). [/b]
[list]a.	Nightmare Respawn Token
b.	Nightmare Party Respawn Token
[/list]

[b]Nightmare Respawn Token Login Reward[/b]
[i]Event Duration: (11/25~12/29)[/i]

[list]Logging in each day during event period will give you Nightmare Respawn Token and Nightmare Party Respawn Tokens for free!
[list]
[b]a.	Free Nightmare Respawn Tokens [/b]- Receive 7pcs of Nightmare Respawn token on your INBOX for logins made during Weekdays (Monday ~ Friday)

[b]b.	Free Nightmare Party Respawn Tokens[/b] - Receive 3pcs of Nightmare Party Respawn token on your INBOX for logins made during Weekends (Saturday ~ Sunday)
[/list][/list]

notes.title: CA Reloaded Patch Notes 2020.11.18 [Black Friday + Combat Week]
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33751039/6a735504a49b0e98b76510e750513adbd3ee8b3f.png[/img]

[h3][b][CHANGELOGS]

1.	Server Stability

2.	Maintenance Downtime Compensation[/b][/h3]
[list]
a.	200% EXP & GP Boost for 2020.11.18 Maintenance for the rest of the day.
b.	Respawn Token 15 pcs.
[list]•	NOTE: MA Compensation can only be obtained on the day of MA after the servers are opened
[/list][/list]

[h3][b]3.	Combat Week Event[/b][/h3]
[list]Push forward Rangers! Support is on its way for the entire week! Play on and take part in expansive bonuses we got in store just for you.

[i]Event Period (11/18 ~ 11/24)[/i]
[list]
[b][u]a.	Bubba’s Secret Stash 2x[/u][/b]
Receive more goodies from our trusty old shopkeeper.

[b][u]b.	Fireteam Bonus Rewards[/u][/b]
Call on your friends, clan mates or just a random group of dedicated rangers to take on the challenges on all Fireteam maps and be rewarded with more or better. Only your squad can determine the outcome!

[b][u]c.	Special Weapons displayed on Bubba’s Secret Stash and the Store.[/u][/b]
Stop worrying about your most coveted gear. We have refreshed the items for the take on BSS and Store so don’t miss out on some possibly interesting deals.

[b][u]d.	Dead Vacation & Snowball Fight Event[/u][/b]
The holiday season is coming fast and we are kicking it off with these game modes made available for those that want something else that they can get their hands on.

[b][u]e.	EXP / GP 100% Buffs[/u][/b]
To top it all off, we are giving a boost to all those duking it out during the Combat Week. We doubling the EXP and GP that you’ll receive on each of your match. That’s right everyone, there is a 100% EXP and GP boost reward during entire Combat Week.

[b][u]f.	New Item Released[/u][/b]
We’ve got a special treat added for our those that wanna go MEGA~!
Grab our newly minted MEGA-5 Special Mystery Box on the Item Shop
[list]
Sale Period  (11/18 ~ 11/24)
[b]Mega-5 Special Mystery Box[/b]
[/list][/list]

This marks the start of the holiday season and what better way to celebrate in by blasting through your games with a little bit or a lot more! Get more for each game with a 100% EXP and 100% GP boost as special treat for Black Friday.

But Black Friday isn’t Black Friday, if not for the ridiculous number of offers and sales we got in store just for you!

Take part in this extravaganza and grab some sweet, sweet gear.

c.	Black Friday Blowout (Black Friday Sale [Part 2]: November 25 to December 1)[/b]

[b]3.	Looking Back, Heading Strong! (3rd Year Valofe Migration and 2nd Year Steam Launch Celebration Event with Returning User Boost)[/b]
[list]
Thank you very much Rangers!

Join in the celebration of two momentous milestones for Combat Arms: Reloaded’s storied history. Let us all cheer in celebration for the 3rd Year of the Combat Arms: Reloaded’s Valofe Migration and the 2nd Year since the launch of Combat Arms: Reloaded on Steam. 
We’ve launched these events to express our indescribable gratitude towards our Rangers that stuck with us through these years.

[b]a.	300% EXP/GP Boost Event[/b]
[i]Event Period: 4.11.2020 – 1.12.2020
Eligibility: All Users[/i]

[b]b.	Special Attendance Event[/b]
[i]Event Period: 4.11.2020 – 1.12.2020
Eligibility: All Users[/i]

Calling upon all Rangers that haven’t checked in the game, we’ve got these very special gifts just for you.

[b]c.	Special Returning User Attendance Event[/b]
[i]Event Period: 4.11.2020 – 1.12.2020

notes.title: DEVELOPERS' BRIEFING #24
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33751039/c7d0f95397424552b8e962bacd9957998c5dce85.png[/img]

Greetings to our Combat Arms Rangers!

This is the development team leader of Combat Arms: Reloaded.

It has been a turbulent year and we just a few months left for 2020. Looking back, time seems to pass quickly.
Nonetheless, I hope that the rest of you spend the remainder of the year well, so that it will be a meaningful year for all our users. With that let's head on over to our Dev Debrief!

We are proud to share that our Line POD channeling service opened last October 14th.
To celebrate the launch, we brought in new events not just for our new Line POD users but for our existing users as well.

Since we want our users to feel 10 out of 10. We are giving away lots of goodies by simply using our promotional coupon. Just enter 'LINEPODASIA' in the promotional code box in the Shop and receive all of the items listed below!!
- Tarot Weapons Mystery box x5
- Valofe Limited Gear Mystery box x5
- 300% EXP/GP Boosts x10

This event is scheduled to run for one month and is valid up until November 13th.
Don't miss out on the rewards we've prepared for our valued users. Make sure to enter the coupon code before November 13th 
We hope that our veteran community will welcome our new players from LINE POD with open arms and stand alongside each other to exciting contents we are rolling out soon!


Moreover, I would like to share some exciting news regarding our progress in the development of much anticipated "Boss War".

We had encountered some little problems and unexpected difficulties due to the current development schedule. However, the content is expected to be added to the game in the Late November Update.

For now, the current concept for the first boss in the game mode is based upon the Outpost31 Boss which has the cold-air attacks in combat.
Additionally, as the game levels progresses higher the bosses' stats and skills' damage output increase as well. The number of mobs in stage will also increase as the level go higher.
And of course, we made sure that the harder the game becomes, the better the rewards the players receive after clearing the mode.
We are working on some tweaks and improvements that will make the 'Boss War' more interesting and most of all, make it fun!
We hope that many of you out there is looking forward to having this content added to Combat Arms: Reloaded.

We will always strive to do our best in order to bring a better game experience for everyone.

Thank you.

notes.title: [Important Announcement] Issues with the Universal Enhancement System
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33751039/a6e83c9c9121cfa9bea3014b9e7dec0989268cfe.png[/img]

Attention Rangers!

We are aware on some issues regarding the newly added Universal Enhancement System. Below are quick fixes to some of the issues reported. 

1. There had been reports regarding the result of enhancement attempts not displaying right after the attempt.
	* Quick Fix: If the enhancement fails, simply log-off and log back in. After logging in, the enhancement should be done on that item. Results maybe success or fail.

2. There had been reports on which the enhancement for an item is locked. This means that you don't have enough materials to proceed with the enhancement.
Items affected by this issue are Items that are already enhanced to +2, +3 and so forth.
	* Quick Fix: You will need to acquire the needed amount of materials for this specific item. You would need to wait for the items to be available again from the Shop.

Rest assured that these issue are being worked and will be fixed on the Schedule Maintenance on September 29, 2020.

Thank you for your unwavering support for Combat Arms: Reloaded.

tags.feature: -Clan occupation has been added to the World Conquest Event.
-Members of the clan cannot choose JSF and CREED and will automatically decide which side they belong to.

-When JSF occupies the map, the clan of the JSF has been most active in the map, and when the CREED occupies the map, the clan of the CREED receives additional rewards. 10 epic metal can be earned for clan rewards.
-World Conquest rewards modified.
-In the case of Elimination, Search & Destroyer, One Man Army, Capture the Flag, Elimination Pro, Last Man Standing, VIP Escort, VIP Elimination, and Tag of War, users may become aliens.
-At this time, if the user who became an alien hunts a human, a reward is obtained at the end of the game.
-Users who hunt aliens also get rewards at the end of the game.
(Aliens cannot hunt when they are on the same side, and hunting does not reward them.)

notes.title: Clan War Event
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33751039/c80fe280a145748d7365c842199be0002367cd99.jpg[/img]


[h1][u][b]Clan War Event[/b][/u][/h1]


The clan war improvement commemoration event started. (Period 5/13 ~ 6/9)
a. 2 times the amount of clan metal
b. 100% EXP & GP Boost added to the clan war


Change of clan war updates
a. The clan war method has been changed so that the clan can freely create and play with each other.
b. In addition, the way Clan Wars scores changes.
Existing >> Win: +30 points, Defeat: -20 points, Draw: +5 points
Change >> Win: +30 points, Defeat: +10 points, Draw: +15 points


================================================================

Das Event zum Gedenken der Verbesserung von Clan Wars hat begonnen. (Zeitraum 13.05. ~ 09.06.)
a. 2-fache Menge von Clan-Metallen
b. 100% EXP & GP Boost zum Clan War hinzugefügt


Änderungen der Clan Wars
a. Die Methode der Clan Wars wurde geändert, damit Clans eigenständig Clan War Räume erstellen können und miteinander spielen können.
b. Außerdem ändert sich die Art und Weise, wie die Clan War Punkte erzielt werden.
Gegenwärtig: >> Gewinn: +30 Punkte, Niederlage: -20 Punkte, Unentschieden: +5 Punkte
Änderung: >> Gewinn: +30 Punkte, Niederlage: +10 Punkte, Unentschieden: +15 Punkte


================================================================

Klan savaşı geliştirme etkinliği başladı. (Dönem: 13 Mayıs ~ 9 Haziran)
a. Klan metal miktarının 2 katı alınabilir
b. Klan savaşına% 100 EXP ve GP Boost eklendi 


Klan savaşı güncellemelerinde değişiklik
a. Klan savaşı sistemi değiştirildi, böylece klanlar birbiriyle özgürce oda oluşturup oynayabilir.
b. Buna ek olarak, Klan Savaşlarının puanları değiştirildi.
Mevcut >> Galibiyet: +30 puan, Mağlubiyet: -20 puan, Beraberlik: +5 puan
Düzenleme >> Galibiyet: +30 puan, Mağlubiyet: +10 puan, Beraberlik: +15 puan


================================================================

Evento en conmemoración de la mejora de las guerras de clanes. (Periodo del 13-05 al 09-06)
a. Doble cantidad de obtención de metales.
b. 100% de EXP/GP adicional en las guerras de clanes.


Cambio en las Guerras de Clanes
a. La forma de jugar las guerras de clanes será libre, pudiendo crear sus salas personalizadas.
b. Además, también se hicieron modificaciones en la puntuación después de una guerra de clan.
Antes >> Victoria: +30 puntos, Derrota: -20 puntos, Empate: +5 puntos
Ahora >> Victoria: +30 puntos, Derrota: +10 puntos, Empate: +15 puntos


================================================================

클랜전 개선 기념 이벤트가 시작됩니다. (기간 5/13~6/9)
a.클랜 메탈 획득 수량 2배
b.클랜전에 EXP/GP 100% 추가


클랜전 방식 변경
a.클랜끼리 자유롭게 방을 만들어서 플레이할 수 있도록 클랜전 방식이 변경됩니다.
b.또한 클랜전의 점수 산정 방식도 변경됩니다.
기존>> 승리: +30점, 패배: -20점, 비김: +5점
수정>> 승리: +30점, 패배: +10점, 비김: +15점 


================================================================

工会战改善纪念日活动. (时间 5/13~6/9)
a. 公会金属获得数量
b. 工会战中增加 EXP/GP 100% 


工会战方式变更
a. 变更公会战方式使公会之间可以自由创建房间进行游戏..
b. 工会战分数计算方式也进行变更.
之前>> 胜利: +30分, 失败: -20分, 平局: +5分
现在>> 胜利: +30分, 失败: +10分, 平局: +15分 


================================================================

クラン戦の改善記念イベントを開催します。(5月13日~6月9日)
a.クランメタル獲得数量2倍
b.クラン戦のEXP/GP 100%追加


クラン戦のルール変更
a.クラン同士で自由にルームを作ってプレイできるよう、ルールが変更されます。
b.クラン戦の点数算定方式が変更されます。
既存>>勝利: +30点、敗北: -20点、引き分け: +5点
修正>>勝利: +30点、敗北: +10点、引き分け: +15点
